children: Greenland Technologies regained compliance with Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid price requirement after 10 consecutive business days at or above $1.00.
Nasdaq notified the company that Class A shares were below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days, triggering a compliance period.
Company received an initial cure period to Sept 8, 2026, then an additional 180-day extension to Mar 8, 2027, if needed.
Closing bid price met $1.00+ for 10 consecutive business days from Sept 8–21, 2026, and Nasdaq confirmed compliance on Sept 22, 2026.
The matter is closed and the company is now in compliance with the Nasdaq minimum bid price requirement.
